description: Prepare Dock's real seat picker for your owner to review who gets Standard or Scale, or prefill a custom-capacity request in Dock's existing support form. Only owner/admin agents may prepare seat actions. action=buy selects seats; action=change proposes moves between Standard and Scale; custom_capacity states the capacity wanted. Return the link to your human. Nothing is charged, changed or submitted by this tool: the human confirms in Dock. Unavailable on non-owner turns.

capacity.description: The custom capacity your human wants; prefilled for their review, never submitted automatically.
